subject: SCIM delta + service-account entitlement reconciliation for Helix Therapeutics
messages:
From: Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@helixtx.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Helix Security <security@helixtx.com>, Mike Carter <mike.carter@helixtx.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SCIM delta + service-account entitlement reconciliation

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the call today. Helix is preparing for a SIG assessment next month and our auditor asked for
artifacts showing how you reconcile SCIM deltas with service-account entitlements and delegated roles.
We specifically need: 
- a recent SCIM delta export (CSV) showing attribute changes for the last 30 days;
- samples of SAML assertion payloads for SSO log correlation;
- mapping of Redwood service accounts to Helix roles; and
- any documentation or scripts you use for least-privilege reviews on service accounts.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Also note Helix requires PII redaction guidance if any user attributes are included.

Thanks,
Jessica
Security Operations
Helix Therapeutics

Attachments: none
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@helixtx.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + service-account entitlement reconciliation

Hi Jessica — good to meet earlier. We're able to provide the items you listed. Quick summary and proposed delivery: 

What we'll deliver (initial package):
- SCIM delta export (CSV) covering 2026-11-20 through 2026-12-20 — includes user.id, externalId, operation, changedAttributes (redacted where needed).
- SAML assertion samples (anonymized; timestamps & NameID preserved for correlation).
- Service-account mapping (XLSX) showing service account -> assigned role(s) in Helix workspace and last-use timestamp.
- Least-privilege matrix (CSV) that shows current role->permission mapping for the service accounts in scope.
- A short runbook (PDF link) describing our redaction process and change reconciliation script references.

ETA: initial package by Wed 2026-12-23 EOD PT.

For PII redaction: we will remove email/local-part hashes and redact personal phone numbers; we will keep stable user ids for traceability and add a mapping key separately for the auditor under an encrypted transfer.

I will attach the package to this thread when ready and include checksums. If you need a DocuSign flow for the NDA addendum before we share mapping keys, let me know.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none (will attach consolidated ZIP 12/23)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + service-account entitlement reconciliation

Looping in operational owners so we can assemble artifacts. Task breakdown: 
- Vanessa: pull SCIM delta CSVs from the provisioning job and run the redaction script (see note below). Include header row and include delta operation type.
- Sean: export SAML assertion samples from last 90 days (anonymize subject attributes but keep assertion IDs). Draft a short note about how we correlate assertion IDs to session logs.
- I'll run the service-account last-use query and generate the mapping sheet; adding a column for "owner_contact" (internal only) so Helix knows who to contact for each service account.

Redaction note: use the redaction tool v2.1 (path: /ops/tools/redact-v2) — replace user email localpart with stable hash (sha256, first 12 chars). Keep timestamp formats ISO-8601.

Target: have attachments staged to the secure drive folder by Tue 2026-12-22 17:00 PT for Olga to review before outbound.

- Jonas

From: Mike Carter <mike.carter@helixtx.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@helixtx.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + service-account entitlement reconciliation

Thanks, team. Quick clarifications from the Helix assessor: 
1) For the SCIM delta, can you include the raw attribute names we requested (displayName, mail, externalId, department) even if redacted, and note which were redacted?
2) For service accounts, we're primarily interested in accounts that have 'write' or 'admin' privileges in the last 180 days. Could you flag those in the mapping?
3) The assessor asked for an auditable checksum for the package and a suggested transfer method (SFTP + signed manifest preferred).

If you can confirm those three items in your package, we'll be able to move forward.

Best,
Mike Carter
Security & Risk
Helix Therapeutics
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Carter <mike.carter@helixtx.com>, Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@helixtx.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Dec 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + service-account entitlement reconciliation

Mike/Jessica — delivered. Summary of package attached to this message and uploaded to the secure drive link below. Checksums are provided (SHA256). Transfer method: we uploaded to the Helix SFTP drop (credentials exchanged via DocuSign channel) and placed a signed manifest file (manifest_signed.json) in the root.

Package contents (attached):
- scim_delta_20261220.csv (includes columns: timestamp, user.id, externalId, operation, displayName(redacted), mail(redacted), department)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 anonymized assertions with assertion IDs + timestamps)
- service-account-mapping.xlsx (flags for write/admin; last_use_date; internal owner)
- least-privilege-matrix.csv (permission => role mapping)
- scim-sync-log-202611.csv (historical sync results)
- manifest_signed.json (SHA256 checksums and package list)

Redaction notes: displayName/mail are masked with stable hash and we include a redaction column that explains which fields were transformed. Sensitive PII removed per your instructions.

If Helix's assessor needs any additional slices (e.g., only service accounts with write access in November 2026), let us know and we can generate a filtered CSV within one business day.

Olga Petrov
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim_delta_20261220.csv, saml_assertion_samples.txt, service-account-mapping.xlsx, least-privilege-matrix.csv, scim-sync-log-202611.csv, manifest_signed.json
